EXPCRIT.Settings.PromptOnCrit.Name: Prompt for damage type on critical rolls
EXPCRIT.Settings.PromptOnCrit.Hint: When a Critical link for a hit location is clicked (damage card, attack card, Critical Cast, /table), ask which Expanded Criticals chart to roll on instead of using the system's table.
EXPCRIT.Settings.ColumnMode.Name: Critical chart column
EXPCRIT.Settings.ColumnMode.Hint: Which die roll column of the Expanded Criticals charts to use. Auto follows the system setting 'Use Up In Arms Critical Hit Modifiers'.
EXPCRIT.Settings.ColumnMode.Auto: Auto (follow the system's Up In Arms setting)
EXPCRIT.Dialog.Title: Expanded Critical: choose a chart
EXPCRIT.Dialog.UiAOn: System Up In Arms critical rules: ON
EXPCRIT.Dialog.UiAOff: System Up In Arms critical rules: OFF
EXPCRIT.Breakdown.Title: Critical roll modifiers
EXPCRIT.Breakdown.MitigationNoTarget: Critical Mitigation: no target on the Test, no AP to apply
EXPCRIT.Breakdown.MitigationHint: Critical Mitigation: if the result is below 1, no Critical Wound is received. Afterwards the outermost armour layer at the location loses 1 AP.
EXPCRIT.Breakdown.MooWounds: Moo's Critical modifiers (Wounds beyond 0 minus TB)
EXPCRIT.Breakdown.BelowTB: Reduced to 0 Wounds by less than Toughness Bonus
EXPCRIT.Mitigation.Title: Critical Mitigation
EXPCRIT.Mitigation.NoCrit: Roll {roll}: {name}'s {ap} AP on the {location} reduced the roll below 1. No Critical Wound is received.
EXPCRIT.Mitigation.NoArmour: Critical Mitigation: {name} has no undamaged physical armour on the {location} to damage.
EXPCRIT.Mitigation.Already: Critical Mitigation: armour was already damaged for this Critical.
EXPCRIT.Mitigation.NoGM: Critical Mitigation: no GM is connected to damage the target's armour; apply 1 armour damage manually.
EXPCRIT.Error.NoTable: Expanded Criticals: no world table for {key} / {column}. Import the module's tables into the world (Compendium > Tables (Expanded Criticals) > Import All). Falling back to the system table.
EXPCRIT.Error.NotActive: Expanded Criticals: module API not available. Is the module enabled?
EXPCRIT.Settings.TestRoller.Name: Who rolls critical Tests
EXPCRIT.Settings.TestRoller.Hint: Criticals that call for a Test (Endurance, Cool, Athletics...) prompt it as soon as they are added to an actor, then apply the result. 'Actor's player' sends the roll dialog to the player who owns the character when the GM adds the critical (falls back to the GM if no owner is online). 'Whoever adds the critical' is the system's default for its own criticals.
EXPCRIT.Tests.NotRolled: The {test} Test was not rolled (dialog closed or no answer). Apply its result by hand.
EXPCRIT.Tests.Speaker: Expanded Criticals
EXPCRIT.Tests.TwoHandedKept: {items} is held in both hands: not dropped, but it can't be used next turn.
EXPCRIT.Tests.MissingItem: Could not find {uuid}. Is the WFRP4e Core Rulebook module enabled? Add it by hand.
